C1618.title: Mitigating Rogue Node Attacks in Edge Computing
C1618.summary: This study proposes a secure authentication protocol for mitigating rogue node attacks in edge computing. Attackers can compromise and impersonate legitimate edge nodes as rogue fog nodes to steal data or disrupt services.
